data.body: SC-DD-AMENDMENT (sc-7 integration test scope): When implementing this story, the test case (c) currently scoped to archived ref-library-loader citation injection MUST BE REPLACED (not stacked) with: creds-in-dso-config.conf startup rejection — assert that placing CONFLUENCE_EMAIL or CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN in dso-config.conf causes a startup rejection (non-zero exit, specific error message). Additionally, ADD test case (d): trailing-slash and missing base_url errors — assert that an unset confluence.base_url rejects all fetches and that a trailing-slash base_url is normalized (both error/normalization paths exercised). Additionally, the stub Confluence server MUST bind to a dynamically-allocated port (no hardcoded port literal) and the test must read the allocated port back for client configuration; tests must run successfully in parallel with another copy of themselves (no port collision). Source: 2026-05-20 preplanning remediation against epic e471-dda3 SC↔DD coverage analysis.
